title: The Maharashtra State Board of Technical Education Act, 1997.
full_text: The Maharashtra State Board of Technical Education Act, 1997. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 199738 Act Number: 38 Enactment Date: 1997-08-06 Act Year: 1997 Short Title: The Maharashtra State Board of Technical Education Act, 1997. Long Title: An Act to provide for establishment of a State Board to regulate matters pertaining to Diploma Level Technical Education in the State of Maharashtra. Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: Higher and Technical Education Department Type: STATE Location: Maharashtra Schedule 1.
